SHIPPED + PUSHED — the TESTER netns seal.what_landed: THE BUG: run_proof() passed proof_path.parent as a RELATIVE cwd to `bwrap --chdir`; inside the network namespace that relative path resolved against the namespace root, so a proof invoked by a relative path came back FALSE RED + seal INDETERMINATE, while the same proof by absolute path sealed correctly. The 'measured, never assumed' seal (Law 3) was silently invocation-dependent — a defect in the notary itself. THE FIX (Law 4, physics not convention): `proof_path = Path(proof_path).resolve()` at the top of run_proof, so the seal cannot depend on how the caller spelled the path. THE TOOTH: test_the_seal_does_not_depend_on_how_the_path_is_spelled runs one fixture via a relative path and asserts identical verdict+seal to absolute (guarded on netns availability). Verified it BITES without the fix, then greens with it.
